Breakdowns / Explainers.name: Riddle to tool
Breakdowns / Explainers.use_when: there's a mental model that changes how people see their own progress, and a tool or demo that makes it real.
Breakdowns / Explainers.needs: a real riddle or example for the model, and something I built or use. Missing → drop the demo and end on the reframe.
Breakdowns / Explainers.reframe: beat 4, right after the lesson. Never line 1.

beats.name: Hook
beats.job: ask a question the viewer wants to guess, with a clear answer coming.

beats.name: Payoff
beats.job: give the answer in one short line so the surprise lands.

beats.name: Name it
beats.job: say the hidden idea the riddle shows, in plain words and why it feels wrong.

beats.name: Reframe
beats.job: turn the lesson to the viewer and tell them where they probably are.

beats.name: Steps
beats.job: one line on what they need to do to get the payoff.

beats.name: Example
beats.job: show something made or used that puts the lesson to work, with proof of how fast.

beats.name: CTA
beats.job: optional. One comment keyword that gets them the tool.

flex: Beat 7 can drop if there's nothing to give.
The demo can be a story or example instead of a tool.

Breakdowns / Explainers.name: Attention first
Breakdowns / Explainers.use_when: a known example shows people no longer come to you, and I can say where attention is now.
Breakdowns / Explainers.needs: a real example people recognise. Missing → don't use this card.
Breakdowns / Explainers.reframe: beat 3. The quote or example flips what people assume. Never line 1.

beats.name: Hook
beats.job: Open with a surprising quote or claim that sets up a flip in how people see success.

beats.name: Example
beats.job: Give a familiar example that makes the quote concrete and easy to picture.

beats.name: Reframe
beats.job: Show how the money really came from something other than the obvious product.

beats.name: Why
beats.job: Apply the example to today's builders and say where attention lives now.

beats.name: Payoff
beats.job: End on the one rule: go where people are, then build a brand to use it.

flex: Beat 2 can merge into the hook.
Add a CTA if there is something to offer.
Swap Garfield for any example people know.

Hero's Journey.name: Lost before change
Hero's Journey.use_when: I felt stuck or lost, and the feeling turned out to be the start of a change.
Hero's Journey.needs: a real story with a clear low point. Missing → don't use this card.
Hero's Journey.reframe: beat 5. Say growth feels like loss, not progress. Never line 1.

beats.name: Hook
beats.job: Open with a quote or claim that says feeling lost is a good sign.

beats.name: Struggle
beats.job: Say what felt wrong and the fear behind it, in plain words.

beats.name: Why
beats.job: Name the cultural belief that made the struggle feel like failure.

beats.name: Reframe
beats.job: Flip it: before every real change comes a lost period, and growth does not feel good.

beats.name: Payoff
beats.job: Say what embracing it gave you and why it mattered.

flex: Add a CTA at the end if there is one.
The hook quote can be swapped for a personal claim.
